mainEntity.name: How long will my nails last?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your set is made to last until your infill, which is usually every 3 to 4 weeks. If a nail breaks within 7 days of your appointment, the repair is free.

mainEntity.name: What’s the difference between BIAB, gel and extensions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gel is a thin layer of colour on your natural nail. BIAB is a builder gel that strengthens your own nails. Extensions add length, in BIAB, polygel or as sculpted slim extensions.

mainEntity.name: What is a Russian manicure, and does it hurt?

acceptedAnswer.text: It’s precise cuticle work that cleans up the cuticle area, so your colour sits right at the base and grows out beautifully. It shouldn’t hurt, and if anything feels uncomfortable, just tell me.

mainEntity.name: Will slim extensions look natural or bulky?

acceptedAnswer.text: Natural. A slim, sculpted extension gives you length and strength without the bulky, fake look.

mainEntity.name: How long does an appointment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A gel manicure takes about 35 minutes, BIAB on natural nails about an hour, and sculpted slim extensions about 2 hours 30 minutes. Nail art adds 10 to 35 minutes, depending on the tier.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to come in with my old set removed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, I’ll remove it for you. Tell me before booking and add removal to your appointment: £5 for gel, or £10 for BIAB or polygel.

mainEntity.name: How often should I book infills?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every 3 to 4 weeks for most clients. Infills are £35 for BIAB, £40 for polygel and £45 for sculpted slim nails.

mainEntity.name: Will it damage my natural nails?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not when it’s done properly. Careful prep, thin, even product and safe removals protect your natural nails. Please tell me about any nail damage, allergies or suspected infections before your appointment.

mainEntity.name: Can I bring a picture of a design I want?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, please do. Book your treatment with the matching nail art tier, and book detailed or 3D designs in advance.

mainEntity.name: What’s your cancellation or late policy?

acceptedAnswer.text: A £10 deposit secures your booking and comes off your total. With at least 48 hours’ notice, it moves to your new appointment; with less, it’s kept. There’s a 15-minute grace period for late arrivals, and missed appointments are charged in full.

mainEntity.name: Is nail art included in the price?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, nail art is added by tier, from £5 for one design type to from £20 for sculpted 3D characters.

mainEntity.name: Do you do pedicures and toenail extensions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Express gel pedicures are £30 and deluxe pedicures £40, and polygel toenail extensions are available as a full set or single nails.

mainEntity.name: Can I bring a friend or my children?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, guests and children are welcome. Just let me know first.
